goal: Prove opt-in Rust cuda-oxide composed FP8 raw-KV storage and compressor row-store execution without claiming pooling, shift, attention, or runtime-route ownership.

cuda_oxide.module_form: executable-local #[cuda_module] with libdevice-linked FP8 quantization and F32/F16 APE row-store reads

covered_behavior: ds4_gpu_kv_fp8_store_raw_tensor sequential FP8 quantize then direct raw-store composition
compressor_store_kernel ratio-4 active-half destination row selection with APE additions
compressor_set_rows_kernel source-to-destination state copying with F32 and F16 APE scalar reads
excluded_behavior: compressor update/prefill wrapper orchestration, norm and RoPE composition, and attention kernels
runtime graph integration, default CUDA route, and C CUDA removal

rust_owned_in_this_stage: executable-local cuda-oxide composed FP8 raw-KV storage launch proof
executable-local cuda-oxide compressor_store_kernel and compressor_set_rows_kernel launch proof
ratio-4 row geometry and F32/F16 APE read numeric validation
not_claimed_in_this_stage: compressor pooling or ratio-4 state shift kernels
compressor wrapper orchestration, normalization, RoPE composition, or attention kernels
runtime graph integration, default CUDA route, or C CUDA removal
